title: Hammer Swords
body:
🔨 **SMASH THE SCALE WITH HAMMER SWORDS!** 🔨💥
Are you tired of the same old flimsy blades? 🗡️ Bored of poking your enemies with toothpicks? It’s time to trade those slender shams for some SERIOUS IMPACT! 👊 Welcome to Hammer Swords, the texture pack that turns your combat kit into a demolition crew! 🏗️ We’ve stripped away the "slice" and replaced it with the SLAM! ⚡ Every sword has been reforged into a heavy-hitting masterpiece of pixelated power! 💎🔨

Why Choose the Hammer Life? 🛠️
HEAVY METAL AESTHETICS: 🎸 From the Stone Smasher 🪨 to the Netherite Mauler 🔥, every tier feels weighted and ready to pulverize! 😤

CRUSHING CONFIDENCE: 💪 Why just "damage" a Creeper when you can flatten it into the dirt? 🌍💥

SATISFYING SWINGS: ⚔️ Your PVP sessions will never feel the same. It’s not just a fight; it’s a demolition derby! 🚜

STUNNING DETAIL: 🎨 Custom textures that keep the Minecraft "soul" while giving your tools a beefy upgrade! ⚙️
